supplied_inputs: quadratic-bijection and length n-r partial-flag existence promises
fixed bad-item density upper bound epsilon < 1/16
persistent chosen-pair comparator and confidence beta
not_supplied: ranks, coefficients, directions, inverse or conditional sampler
bad-item identities or iid comparison noise

claims.claim: At a true acquired prefix, a fixed quadratic own-toggle candidate has mean normalized maximal matching score at most 2epsilon if true, and at least 1/4-2epsilon-c_m if false, where c_m=binom(2m,m)/(2*4^m).
claims.conditions: Fresh iid sampled positions in each half per fresh uniform true prefix; fixed arbitrary bad-item set; candidate fixed before validation; repeats allowed.

claims.claim: Greedy maximal matching suffices for the same cut gap, with at most m^2 comparisons per batch; maximum matching is unnecessary.

Inside any even true prefix fiber containing b bad items, observed-predecessor count threshold at half the fiber mislabels at most 2b items. Global raw next-bit error is at most 2epsilon, so local unique quadratic RM correction completes residual bits.

For fixed r and fixed strict noise gap, corrected candidate bodies plus matching validation and robust residual completion give a polynomial capped comparison learner for the exact full quadratic decoder with failure at most beta.
claims.cost: Expected O(2^r n^3 log n), worst O(2^r n^3 log^2 n), with fixed r,beta,noise gap; all local-correction and validation constants explicitly charged.
claims.limits: Not a zero-semantic-error certificate; M corrected anchors may be acquired for every attempted direction; the pinned-cube confidence factor is not erased.
claims.execution_scope: One n=5,r=2,epsilon=1/32,beta=0.5 local-cube matching run on fixed-B persistent total-order corruption; exact all ranks/fibers/inverses, 9577605 source comparisons. Deterministic raw-label caching charged.

claims.claim: With fair independent equality ties, an odd s-sample comparator-majority label in a true prefix fiber has global expected error at most 2epsilon+binom(s,(s-1)/2)/2^(s+1), independently of fiber size. Fresh label randomness is compatible with pinned-cube RM correction.

Directly RM-correct median labels to acquire each next coordinate, then solve its own-toggle equations, avoiding random direction search. With the robust residual routine its fixed-gap comparison cap is O(n^3 log n + 2^r n^2 log n).
claims.execution_scope: Only n=3,r=1,epsilon=0,beta=0.5 local smoke executed: exact all ranks/fibers/inverses, 14860098 source comparisons. Corrupted-source finite controls use an explicitly exponential-n whole-cube decoder.

claims.claim: For r>=2 there are two quadratic partial-flag ideals with different requested flagged prefix and a common observed total order, each explained by a bad set of density 1/16. Checked at n/r=4/2 and 5/3.
claims.limits: Not a separate sharpness result for every smaller r or requested prefix configuration.

claims.claim: Change to the acquired toggle basis after validation: flagged payload Dprefix=h+C(n,2)-C(r,2)+C(n,3)-C(r,3), plus rM suffix coefficients and n^2 basis bits. Decode, invert and sample requested prefixes with zero new source calls; inversion/residual filtering costs 2^r arithmetic work.
claims.limits: Storage compression does not erase previously acquired corrected candidate anchors or source work.

claims.claim: An explicit degree-d noisy interpolating set of O(n^d) positions tolerating theta_d errors turns constant-confidence corrected labels eta=theta_d/4 into a whole-body proposal correct with probability at least 3/4 by Markov, removing the per-anchor confidence log from proposal acquisition.
claims.limits: NIS code family, numerical constants and decoding work have not been implemented or benchmarked. Failed bodies are handled by fresh semantic validation and capped retries.

claims.claim: For raw labels with global expected error rho<2^(-d-1), a true candidate has fresh uniform discrepancy at most rho and a false degree-d candidate at least 2^-d-rho. Threshold 2^(-d-1) and fresh Hoeffding tests validate entire bodies without matching or a direction search.
claims.limits: Fresh randomized median seeds/coins per evaluation are required by the current proof; a cached randomized-label table or shared sample pool is not assumed.

claims.claim: Translation cocycle and top-degree invariance make each derivative-degree filtration map linear on its current subspace; descending kernels compute exact periods and constant-one toggles in polynomial n work for fixed degree d.
claims.execution_scope: All 32768 four-variable degree<=3 polynomials and 1000 restricted-subspace degree3/4 cases agree with exact truth tables. Sparse storage implementation also passes constructed n=64,d=3 and n=128,d=4 cases without domain enumeration.

claims.claim: For epsilon<2^(-d-2), fixed degree d, supplied partial-flag existence and fixed persistent bad-item noise, constant-confidence NIS bodies plus fresh direct raw-label validation recover the full decoder with failure at most beta. Expected comparisons are O(n^(d+1)+2^r n^d+(n+2^r)log(n/beta)), with explicit capped first-wrong-event accounting.
claims.limits: No full NIS compiler execution, chosen-code constants, practical performance, optimality, novelty or real-source grounding is established.

claims.claim: For r>=d, the adjacent-block construction Q_b=(z,q_b,u_1+q_b,...,u_d+q_b,w), q_b=x0+b*prod u_i, gives two valid degree-d partial-flag ideals with different requested flagged prefix and a shared observed total order at bad-item density 2^(-d-2).
claims.execution_scope: n/r/d=5/3/3 and 6/4/3: all clean pairs, bijections, flags and coordinate degrees checked.
claims.limits: No separate sharpness claim for special r<d or smaller requested prefixes.

claims.claim: No real consequential chosen-pair service with independently certified quadratic class, partial flag and persistent item-noise budget has been acquired. Exact class recognition, novelty, optimal query complexity and all-resource advantage remain unestablished.
